prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported no visible damage to the roadway or other traffic. Insured vehicle has damage to the rear quarter panel and driver side mirror. Claimant vehicle has damage to the front passenger door. Police report requested. Claimant is not represented by an attorney.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck and back strain following the impact and states symptoms began within an hour. Claimant has not yet seen a physician. Advised claimant on the process for medical documentation and provided the list of covered medical providers. Claimant stated intent to seek care this week. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 3: Reviewed the police report. Responding officer documented the other driver as at fault for failing to yield before changing lanes. Witness statement from a passenger in the insured vehicle is consistent with the insured's account. Liability appears clear. Claimant has not indicated any intent to retain counsel at this time.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a copy of an initial urgent care visit record. Diagnosis listed as cervical and lumbar strain. Treatment recommended includes rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and physical therapy referral. Claimant has asked how the claim will be handled. Explained that the injury portion will be evaluated once treatment records and any follow-up care are received.

Entry 5: Physical therapy evaluation report received from claimant. Claimant is attending sessions and reports gradual improvement in range of motion. Repair estimate for claimant vehicle reviewed and approved. Rental coverage confirmed for claimant. File remains open pending completion of treatment and receipt of final medical billing. Next follow-up call scheduled.
